candidats.titre: File:Santappa Nayak Tirumala temple, Bhatkal Karnataka.jpg
candidats.description: Location of this monument: Position de l'objet 13° 58′ 59,8″ N, 74° 33′ 50,62″ E Voir cet endroit et d’autres images sur : OpenStreetMap 13.983277; 74.564062 Bhatkal is a small town in the Kanara region of the northwestern Karnataka. It was a large historic trading hub during the Vijayanagara era, a period that witnessed the construction of numerous Jain and Hindu temples. It is notable for its unique style of Hindu and Jain architecture that is not in Vijayanagara style, but is an evolution in the Chalukyan style adapted to periods of heavy monsoon rains and humid environment.
